sources.entry: Snip - Application for sharing captured images on QQ Mail. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Snip
summary.one_liner: Snip is a Mac screenshot and annotation app from QQ Mail that captures screen regions, scrolling windows and shares captured images via QQ Mail.
use_cases: Capture a long scrolling webpage or window on a Mac
Annotate screenshots with arrows, shapes and handwriting
Share a screenshot by email through QQ Mail
Capture a specific window with one click
summary.what_it_does: Snip captures the full screen, a custom region, or an automatically detected window, with a scrolling-area capture option that grabs an entire scrolling window in one click. It supports annotation with rectangle, ellipse and arrow tags, text, and handwriting brushes, and tags can be moved, resized and recolored. Captured images are saved to the desktop by default (changeable in Preferences) or to the clipboard, and keyboard shortcuts can be customized. It can also link to a QQ Mail account to share captures directly from the compose page.
notable: Scrolling area capture with one click
Annotation tags, text and handwriting brushes
caveats: Requires Mac OS X 10.6.8 or higher
Scrolling capture and QQ Mail plugin are not available in the Mac App Store version; download from the official website
